observation: GitHub push paths-ignore suppressed production reconciliation for changes to workflow, Supabase, and BRAIN paths.
intervention: Remove push paths-ignore, retain existing deploy applicability gate.
expected: Every main push invokes snapshot reconciliation, only deploy-eligible changes proceed to Netlify.
validation: Required CI, CodeQL, protected merge, exact production readback required; no deployment claimed.
root_cause: Workflow-level paths-ignore prevented GitHub Actions dispatch for operational-path changes, bypassing the existing internal deployment applicability check.
prevention_rule: All main pushes must enter the reconciliation workflow; deployment applicability remains evaluated inside the workflow. Regression test verifies both conditions.
